relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (JingYuan.ts:352): The Ashblazing Grand Duke 4-piece (its ATK stacks are a kit/scenario conditional).

ornament_set.name: The Wondrous BananAmusement Park
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (JingYuan.ts:356): The Wondrous BananAmusement Park (+16% CRIT DMG, +32% more while a target the wearer summoned is on the field; whether Lightning-Lord counts is Fribbels' modelling and unchecked here).

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG, Feet ATK%/SPD, Sphere ATK%/Lightning DMG, Rope ATK%. GUESS: Body CRIT Rate (proxy +5.1% over CRIT DMG). GUESS: Feet SPD, same reason as Acheron (SPD boots in the 0% baseline, benchmarks.md:65). Sphere Lightning DMG (proxy +9.7% over ATK%). Rope ATK% is the only option.

spd_target.reason: Turn breakpoint: 20000/150 = 133.33 SPD, so 133.34 gives 2 turns in the first 150 AV cycle (src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1). His Fribbels list has SPD last (JingYuan.ts:332-337) but no stated target.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, ATK%, ATK. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: crit rolls fill toward their caps (CRIT DMG 11, CRIT Rate 10). SPD: target 133.34 (K14e, turn breakpoint). 99 + 25.032 + 4.6 = 128.632; 3 distributed rolls make 135.532 (margin 2.192), 2 make 133.232 (0.108 short). Under the cap of 10. GUESS: Jing Yuan's own Lightning-Lord timing may want a different tune; the kit file will show it. Changed from the earlier draft: no change to the split. Priority: file counts (CRIT DMG 11, CRIT Rate 10), then ATK% and ATK from Fribbels' list. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
